title: Needs-Lead queue (P-611 (2), row G-1)
description: One object per lane report, question, blocker or approval that waits on the Lead. Written by tools/items.py only (add, ack, done, ingest). Open and not acked over 45 min = ACT in lead-watch; over 90 min = a FOUNDER line; tools/handover.sh (row G-2) refuses while any item is open.

id.description: Backlog row or item id from the LANE-REPORT line, unique in the file

owner.description: Who reported it (role, lane or GitHub login)

pr.description: PR the report was posted on

status.description: open = waits on the Lead and is not acknowledged

updated_at.description: Last report on this id; timeouts count from here

opened_at.description: When it last became open (new, or reopened after an ack or done); the 45/90-min timeouts count from here, so a repeat report never resets them

source.description: Comment id of the last report ingested, or 'manual'; makes ingest idempotent
